operation.summary: Generate one image through Azure Sunburst or OpenRouter FLUX 3 Image Klein; 40 per linked account per calendar month UTC, shared across devices and applet wordmarks

body.name: task_key
body.description: Registered applet image task; image_generation by default. Resolves live applet/account model preferences; Azure Sunburst by default; flux_image_generation selects FLUX 3 Image Klein

body.name: quality
body.description: Quality; medium by default, and the only supported FLUX quality

body.name: background
body.description: Transparent requires png and the Azure service

operation.example: POST /v1/images/generations {"prompt":"An otter in a purple scarf"}
operation.returns: provider, model, request_id, data[{b64_json}], size, quality, output_format, usage, cost_usd, quota{limit,used,remaining,resets_at}. Idempotency-Key required; retry unknown outcomes only with the same key; results kept privately 24 hours

background.description: Transparent requires png and the Azure service

task_key.description: Registered applet image task; image_generation by default. Resolves live applet/account model preferences; Azure Sunburst by default; flux_image_generation selects FLUX 3 Image Klein

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice

quality.description: Quality; medium by default, and the only supported FLUX quality
